kind_note: multi-agent orchestration harness for mathematical reasoning
note: Danus is an orchestration system for research-level mathematical reasoning with a shared fact graph as global memory-management mechanism. Described as a multi-agent harness consisting of a main agent for planning and coordination, multiple worker agents for parallel proof search, and a stateless verifier. The system was released via arXiv paper submission on 2026-07-07.
